question: What contrasting facial qualities define this terrible aspect?
premises: The form is terrible with knitted brows.
The form also has an excellent auspicious face.
inference: This terrible, frowning, black-faced aspect also possesses an excellent auspicious face.
uncertainties: Whether śrī+mukha+uttamā refers to a separate face or a quality of the same aspect is ambiguous.
plain_english: She is terrible with knitted brows, black-faced, yet possessing an excellent auspicious face.
